text:
```yaml
name: GitHub AI Moderator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created, edited]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created, edited]

jobs:
  moderate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Moderate with GitHub AI
        uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
        with:
          labels: |
            {
              "spam": "spam",
              "ai-generated": "ai-generated"
            }
          minimize: true
```
